comments.body_html:
Hello fellow AK enjoyer,

First of all, I absolutely love this mod, it was actually one of the reasons I started playing SPT in the first place!

I’ve been using this mod alongside SPT-realism mod, and I’ve been running into an issue where bots with short-barrelled AKs like the RD or AK102/104 have glitched handguards which make them unable to shoot or equip to my PMC. I was trying to resolve this issue on my own until I read your earlier comment - posted today - where you addressed this issue, but I have one additional question:

I’ve looked through your bot_mods.json file as well as the SPT realism bot loadout .json files, and one major difference is the fact that in SPT-realism (or vanilla tarkov), several AI loadouts have the handguards listed as attached to the gas block, not the weapon itself (based on ParentIDs). Is this something that is incompatible with your mod?

Below is an abbreviated version of an SPT-realism Bear AK-102 weapon loadout:

3BearAK102v3

“_id“: “2733b1d03baec63d5e65c521”,

“_tpl”: “5ac66d015acfc400180ae6e4”,

“_id“: “d7c8b46a2e6d8ce83dacc9d2”,

“_tpl”: “59c6633186f7740cf0493bb9”,

“parentId”: “2733b1d03baec63d5e65c521”, ——— base weapon ID

“slotId”: “mod_gas_block”

“_id“: “030807c8b72974cf470f46b6”,

“slotId”: “mod_handguard”

(note how the handguard is listed as attached to the gas block, not the weapon directly…)

I am not a programmer and have next to no experience in modding, but I wanted to post this here in case it might help you or someone else looking to make this mod compatible with other mods.

Thank you again for your time and effort.
